title: Administrator (Financial Services)
description:
FindCore are thrilled to be assisting an established independent wealth management firm with the recruitment of a Wealth Management Administrator.

The company is based in central Leeds and provides bespoke wealth-management and financial-planning services to private clients. It has operated since 2004 and focuses on building long-term client relationships through independent, tailored advice.

Permanent position. This role will initially be office-based during the training period, with hybrid working available once the successful candidate is fully trained.

Salary

Fully negotiable, depending on experience and capabilities + discretionary bonus + private medical insurance + additional benefits

Key Responsibilities
- Provide administrative support to the Client Service Directors and wider wealth-management team.
- Prepare and pre-complete client application forms.
- Produce cost and charges disclosure documents.
- Obtain provider illustrations and supporting product information.
- Prepare factsheets, Key Investor Information Documents and other pre-advice paperwork.
- Submit new business applications and investment trades through investment platforms and life companies.
- Ensure all applications and trades are completed accurately and within the required deadlines.
- Maintain accurate transaction records to support valuation reconciliation.
- Support the onboarding of new clients and ensure client files are complete and compliant.
- Add and update client information within the iO back-office system.
- Complete the relevant iO workflows and maintain accurate diary entries.
- Check that anti-money laundering and compliance requirements have been satisfied.
- Submit letters of authority to providers and obtain policy information.
- Ensure client files contain all required agreements, reports and supporting documentation.
- Confirm files are fully compliant before new business is submitted.
- Maintain accurate electronic and paper-based client records.
- Provide general office support, including filing, scanning, photocopying, post and franking.

Skills & Experience
- Minimum of three years' experience in a similar administrative role within financial services.
- Strong organisational skills with the ability to manage multiple tasks and deadlines.
- Excellent attention to detail and commitment to accuracy.
- Strong written and verbal communication skills.
- Competent using Microsoft Word and Excel to an intermediate level.
- Professional, dependable and comfortable working within a client-focused environment.

What's on Offer
- Fully negotiable salary based on experience and capabilities.
- Hybrid working following the initial office-based training period.
- Employer pension contribution.
- Death-in-service benefit of four times annual salary.
- 24 days' annual leave plus bank holidays.
- Discretionary bonus.
- Vitality private medical insurance.
- Professional examination support and training.
- Opportunity to join an established independent wealth-management business.
- Supportive and highly experienced team environment.
- Central Leeds office location.

For further information on this opportunity, or any other jobs, please apply via the link below or contact FindCore in the strictest confidence.

title: Claims Handler - Defendant Personal Injury (EL/PL)
description:
Role: Claims Handler - Defendant Personal Injury (EL/PL) Location: Leeds, West Yorkshire Contract: Full time, permanent, hybrid Salary: £28,000 - £32,000 CRA Consulting is pleased to be working alongside a well-established national law firm to recruit a Claims Handler into its expanding Defendant Personal Injury department. This is a fantastic opportunity to join a firm with a strong reputation within the insurance sector, acting on behalf of insurer and commercial clients across a broad range of personal injury matters. The team offers a collaborative working environment, high-quality training, and genuine opportunities for long-term career development.

The Opportunity

You'll take ownership of a caseload of defendant Employer's Liability and Public Liability claims, managing matters from initial instruction through to settlement. Working closely with colleagues and clients, you'll ensure claims are progressed efficiently, balancing excellent client service with commercial outcomes. Key responsibilities will include:
- Managing a varied caseload of defendant EL and PL claims through the MOJ Claims Portal.
- Investigating liability and quantum by reviewing evidence, medical reports and supporting documentation.
- Maintaining regular contact with insurer clients, claimant representatives, experts and other key stakeholders.
- Negotiating settlements and identifying opportunities to achieve commercially favourable outcomes.
- Pursuing recovery actions where appropriate.
- Maintaining accurate case records, financial reserves and risk assessments.
- Ensuring compliance with client protocols, regulatory requirements and internal quality standards.
- Contributing positively to team objectives while consistently meeting individual performance targets.

About You

Applications are welcomed from experienced Defendant Personal Injury Claims Handlers who enjoy managing their own caseload and working within a fast-paced environment. To be successful, you'll ideally have:
- Experience handling defendant EL and/or PL claims.
- Confidence using the MOJ Claims Portal.
- A solid understanding of liability, quantum and the personal injury claims process.
- Strong negotiation and communication skills.
- The ability to prioritise a busy workload while maintaining excellent attention to detail.
- A client-focused approach with a commitment to delivering a high standard of service.

Candidates with a background in defendant RTA claims who are keen to develop their expertise within Employer's Liability and Public Liability work are also encouraged to apply.

Benefits

Alongside a competitive salary, the firm offers an extensive benefits package designed to support both your professional development and wellbeing, including:
- 25 days' annual leave plus bank holidays.
- Additional annual leave with length of service.
- Holiday purchase scheme.
- Enhanced pension contributions.
- Private healthcare.
- Life assurance.
- Enhanced family leave provisions.
- Discounted legal services.
- Employee Assistance Programme and wellbeing support.
- Reward and recognition initiatives.
- Regular social events and long service awards.
- Travel schemes.
- Hybrid and flexible working arrangements.

Why Join?

This is an excellent opportunity to become part of a highly regarded national practice that genuinely invests in its people. You'll benefit from quality work, a supportive team environment and structured career progression, whether you're already experienced in EL/PL claims or looking to make the move from defendant RTA into a broader personal injury role.

title: Complaints Handler
description:
A growing business is looking for a number of new colleagues to join its Complaints Administration and Investigations Teams and become part of the wider business. Staring early September, these hybrid roles are based from our new Leeds city centre offices, and offer excellent training and development opportunities within a growing, supportive business. What's in it for you?
- The opportunity to work within a fast-growing company with a clear mission and values that are actively lived every day
- Hybrid working from our modern Leeds city centre office following your initial training period onsite
- Investment in training and development to support your career aspirations
- Pension scheme
- 33 Days annual holiday allowance (inclusive of Bank Holidays)
- Employee Discounts and Cashback Schemes
- Discounted Parking and local gym memberships
- Onsite refreshments provided

As a Trainee Complaints Handler, you will:
- Act as the first point of contact for customer enquiries, handling calls, emails, and written correspondence professionally and courteously
- Provide progress updates and administrative support throughout the complaint journey, ensuring all case notes, actions, and outcomes are accurately recorded in real time
- Ensure all complaint logging, acknowledgements, and progress updates meet regulatory requirements and deadlines
- Investigate and resolve customer complaints relating to customer service and payment-related issues
- Act as a brand ambassador for the business and the end client, delivering a high standard of service at all times

What we're looking for in a Trainee Complaints Handler We're keen to speak with candidates who have proven experience working within a Telephony or Complaint Handling role within a Financial Service environment and who demonstrate a genuine passion for delivering excellent client outcomes. You will be able to demonstrate:
- Experience in Complaints or Customer Service, preferably within a Regulated Financial Services Setting.
- Understanding of complaints environments and regulatory compliance.
- Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
- Strong administrative skills and previous experience of updating Customer records and systems.
- Ability to work independently, prioritise tasks, and manage time effectively.
- Proficiency in Microsoft Office.
- Alignment with our core values: Collaborative, Entrepreneurial, Relationship-Driven and Committed to Delivery Excellence
- An outstanding work ethic combined with a desire for continuous learning and personal development, staying updated on best practices, emerging market trends, and regulatory changes.
- A commitment to fairness, integrity, and compliance with all relevant processes, laws, and regulations

Benefits Working hours are Monday-Friday, between the hours of 08:30-17:30 (40 hours per week). No weekends or evening shifts required. To apply for this role as a Complaints Handler, please click apply online and upload an updated copy of your CV.Candidate Source Ltd is an advertising agency. Once you have submitted your application it will be passed to the third party Recruiter who is responsible for processing your application. This will include holding and sharing your personal data, our legal basis for this is legitimate interest subject to your declared interest in a job. Our privacy policy can be found on our website and we can be contacted to confirm who your application has been forwarded to.

title: Sales Ledger Administrator
description:
Abbeygate Search is supporting an established business in Leeds with the appointment of a Sales Ledger Administrator on a 12-month fixed term contract.

This is a varied, hands-on position within a busy finance team. It would suit someone with previous sales ledger, accounts receivable or credit control experience who enjoys keeping accounts accurate, resolving queries and working closely with customers and internal departments.

The role
- Maintaining customer accounts and ensuring information is accurate
- Processing invoices, credit notes and account adjustments
- Allocating incoming payments
- Reconciling customer accounts and investigating discrepancies
- Monitoring outstanding balances and following up overdue payments
- Responding to invoice and payment queries
- Producing regular sales ledger and aged-debt reports
- Supporting the wider finance team with general administrative duties

About you
- Previous experience within sales ledger, accounts receivable or credit control
- Confident working with a high volume of transactions
- Comfortable speaking with customers and resolving account queries
- Good Excel skills and experience using an accounting or ERP system
- SAP experience would be particularly useful, although comparable systems will be considered
- Accurate, organised and able to manage competing priorities
- Available to begin a new position at relatively short notice

The position is based on-site in Leeds and offers a salary of approximately £27,000-£29,000, depending on experience.

Please apply with your CV or contact Abbeygate Search for a confidential conversation.
